description: Calculates take-home (net) pay for a US employee in any of the 50 states or DC for tax year 2025 or 2026: federal income tax from the IRS Rev. Proc. 2024-40 / 2025-32 bracket tables with the One Big Beautiful Bill Act standard deduction ($15,750 single for 2025, $16,100 for 2026), Social Security with the wage base ($176,100 in 2025, $184,500 in 2026), Medicare plus the 0.9% Additional Medicare tax, and state income tax. State tax is exact from each state's 2026 schedule for CA, NY, NJ, IL, PA, GA, NC; other states return a labeled effective-rate estimate (method: "estimate"). Handles pre-tax 401(k) (not FICA-exempt) and payroll HSA (FICA-exempt), and Pennsylvania/New Jersey rules that tax 401(k) or HSA money. Returns per-period and annual figures. Local taxes (NYC etc.) are out of scope. Figures copied from irs.gov and state revenue sites in Oct 2026.

filing_status.description: Federal filing status. Qualifying surviving spouse uses married_filing_jointly.

gross_annual.description: Gross annual pay in USD before any deduction. Give this OR gross_per_period.

gross_per_period.description: Gross pay for one pay period in USD. Multiplied by the periods in pay_frequency.

hsa_annual.description: HSA contribution through payroll (cafeteria plan) for the year in USD. Lowers income tax, Social Security and Medicare.

pay_frequency.description: Pay frequency: weekly (52), biweekly (26, default), semimonthly (24), monthly (12), quarterly (4) or annual (1).

pretax_401k_annual.description: Traditional (pre-tax) 401(k) deferral for the year in USD. Lowers income tax, not FICA. Leave out for Roth.

pretax_401k_percent.description: Traditional 401(k) deferral as a percent of gross (e.g. 6). Use instead of pretax_401k_annual.

state.description: US state or DC: two-letter code (CA), name (California) or slug (new-york).

name: calculate_take_home_pay
title: Paycheck calculator: take-home pay
